META_DESCRIPTION: Track tuition, courses, books, and loan repayments. FincWin's Education envelope makes your knowledge investment visible.
HERO_H1:
Every dollar spent on learning
is an investment that compounds.
HERO_SUB: Tuition, online courses, textbooks, certifications, student loan payments — education spending is some of the most important money you'll ever spend. FincWin helps you track it intentionally.
PAIN_H2:
Education spending is easy
to justify and forget to track.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: Student loan payments that feel like background noise
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: $380/month for 10 years. You set the autopay and stopped thinking about it. But $380/month is $4,560/year — money with a purpose you've stopped being intentional about.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: Online courses you bought but never finished
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: $200 for a Udemy course that's been sitting at 14% complete since February. $89 for that book that's still in plastic wrap. Education impulse buys add up like any other.
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: Back-to-school hits your account in August
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: School supplies, uniforms, activity fees, new laptop — August can cost $600–$1,200 if you have kids in school. Without a quarterly budget, it derails everything else.
CARD_1_P: Log your student loan payments as recurring monthly expenses. See your total education debt commitment at a glance — and watch it shrink over time.
CARD_2_P: Set an annual education cap for courses, certifications, and books. FincWin shows your progress toward that cap so you know exactly how much learning budget you have left.
CARD_3_P: Tag August and September as high-education months. FincWin helps you build a higher envelope cap for back-to-school season so it never feels like a surprise.
